name: OmaOneDrive
author: Salem Sayed
description: OneDrive status, timed pause controls, cloud storage, and recent sync activity in the Omarchy bar, for one account or several.

barWidget.description: Control and temporarily pause the OneDrive CLI, check cloud status, and open recent local files. Discovers every configured account and shows the one that most needs attention.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify when OneDrive needs attention, recovers, or cloud storage is almost full. Events from several accounts are grouped into one notification.

schema.label: Local refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Reads the local service, journal, and cached cloud status. It does not contact Microsoft. With several accounts the interval is shared: each account is polled once per interval, staggered across it.

schema.label: Recent files
schema.description: Maximum number of recently modified local OneDrive files shown in the panel, for the selected account.

schema.label: Panel layout
schema.description: Full shows storage and recent activity. Compact shows storage only, in a shorter panel. Both show the account selector when more than one account exists.
